1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000020_GOSETSU
1.description: Please, Tsuyu. I am not so frail that I cannot feed myself.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000030_GOSETSU
2.description: Ah, I grow weary of the taste of gruel...

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000040_YOTSUYU
3.description: You don't like it? Can I fetch you something else?

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000050_GOSETSU
4.description: Aye. Wine! Or if that is not “wholesome” enough─I don't know...a sweet persimmon from Namai? I enjoyed them in my youth.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000070_GOSETSU
6.description: Nay, pay me no mind─I am full. Besides, we have guests.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000080_ALISAIE
7.description: I hope we are not interrupting your meal. We had heard you were confined to bed, and thought you might welcome some visitors.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000100_GOSETSU
9.description: A trifle drained from my exertions, perhaps. But with a little rest, I shall be fighting fit again in no time!

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000120_ALISAIE
11.description: Gosetsu! Is this how you've been spending your time!?

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000130_GOSETSU
12.description: My lady, I assure you, this is not─

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000140_YOTSUYU
13.description: Off with them. We need to wash you─you stink!

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000160_YOTSUYU
15.description: What are all these scars? There are so many of them...

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000170_GOSETSU
16.description: A life of battle will leave its mark upon a man...

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000200_GOSETSU
19.description: Bah, leave me be, woman! I will not be fussed over like some newborn babe!

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000230_YOTSUYU
22.description: Greetings. Might I have one of y─ Wait! Please!<hex:02100103>...I only wanted a persimmon.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000240_E3F2VILLAGERE
23.description: Kami save us! Her spirit has returned!

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000250_E3F2VILLAGERF
24.description: She's back from the dead to seek her revenge!

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000260_ISSE
25.description: It can't be! She couldn't have survived!

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000270_YOTSUYU
26.description: What did I... Wh-What did I do?

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000290_HIEN
28.description: Good people of Namai─be at ease, I pray you! You have naught to fear!

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000300_ISSE
29.description: My lord, forgive me but─what is that monster doing here!? They told us she was dead!

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000310_HIEN
30.description: I too was surprised to learn of her survival.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000320_HIEN
31.description: More even than you, I would hazard. 'Twas I who cut her down. I who left her to her fate.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000330_HIEN
32.description: But it would seem the kami had other plans. By some miracle, both she and Gosetsu were spared when the keep collapsed─though Yotsuyu's preservation came at the cost of her memory.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000340_ISSE
33.description: You're saying she's <hex:021A020203>forgotten<hex:021A020103>? Forgotten everything she's done!?

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000350_E3F2VILLAGERF
34.description: Lies! Lies, my lord! She would say anything to escape punishment!

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000360_E3F2VILLAGERE
35.description: What does it matter!? <hex:021A020203>We<hex:021A020103> have not forgotten her crimes! And we demand justice! I beg of you, Lord Hien, draw your blade and rid us of this canker!

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000370_YOTSUYU
36.description: What I saw, then. It's all true.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000380_YOTSUYU
37.description: I'm sorry! I'm so, so sorry...

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000390_ISSE
38.description: You're “sorry”!? And what, we're supposed to forgive you?

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000400_AZAMI
39.description: Here, there's no need to cry.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000410_AZAMI
40.description: Can't you see how scared she is? How can you be scared of her? She's not the same.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000420_HIEN
41.description: Until such time as her memories return, this woman shall be known as “Tsuyu,” and treated as a citizen of Doma.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000430_HIEN
42.description: I will, however, see that she is watched at all times. Rest assured that there will be no more unannounced visits to the village. As your lord, I ask that you leave her fate in my hands, and suffer her to live. For now.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000450_ISSE
44.description: All right. I'll keep my peace.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000460_ISSE
45.description: As long as you're happy. That's all that matters.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000470_ASAHI
46.description: What a pleasure it is to see you once more, Lord Hien. Not to mention my dear sister.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000480_HIEN
47.description: A pleasure to see you too, Ambassador. Forgive us our late arrival.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000490_HIEN
48.description: You have our people aboard the airship?

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000500_ASAHI
49.description: Exactly as agreed. We would leave you in no doubt as to the purity of our intentions. I daresay it was the selfsame spirit of cooperation which prompted you to bring Yotsuyu here today.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000510_HIEN
50.description: Indeed. Before excluding her from the exchange, I thought it only fair that you see her condition for yourself. Physically, she is in fine health, but her mind is unchanged.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000521_ASAHI
52.description: But all need not necessarily be lost. In anticipation of this tragic turn of events, I took the liberty of inviting some special guests...

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000560_ASAHI
56.description: Is something wrong, dear sister? These are our beloved parents. Does not the sight of them bring back sweet childhood memories?

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000580_YOTSUYU
58.description: ...Gosetsu. I have to take this to Gosetsu...

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000590_ASAHI
59.description: Hmph. It would seem my little surprise was not sufficient.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000600_ASAHI
60.description: You needn't glare at me so, Lord Hien─I merely did what any loving son would do for his family. Lest you doubt, I am content to leave the acting viceroy in your care. Pray treat her as you would any daughter of Doma.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000610_ASAHI
61.description: Do not grow too fond of this place, dear sister. You will come back to us ere long.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000620_HIEN
62.description: We continue with the exchange as planned, then.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000630_ASAHI
63.description: Very good. The structure across the river should serve our needs. We shall await you there with the conscripts if you would bring your captives...?

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000660_GOSETSU
66.description: My lord! Come in, come in...

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000670_GOSETSU
67.description: When Tsuyu returned, her eyes were red from weeping. She spoke not a word─simply sat and peeled some fruit she'd brought for me.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000680_GOSETSU
68.description: She then claimed weariness and retired to her chamber. Tell me, what happened to upset her so?

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000690_HIEN
69.description: The ambassador arranged a surprise reunion with her foster parents. A misguided attempt to restore Yotsuyu to her senses.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000700_HIEN
70.description: It was plain their presence caused her great distress, but she seemed otherwise unaffected.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000710_ALISAIE
71.description: Yotsuyu was mistreated as a child, was she not? It was a cruel trick to use her tormentors like that, knowing the pain it could cause.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000720_GOSETSU
72.description: Hmph. I like this Asahi less and less...

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000730_HIEN
73.description: Be that as it may, he has agreed to allow Yotsuyu to remain with us in Doma. Our primary concern now is to hand over the prisoners without incident, and bring our people safely home.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000740_ALPHINAUD
74.description: There was one other detail at the meeting which caught my attention.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000750_ALPHINAUD
75.description: I assume you all noticed the rather suspect crates within the castrum? The imperials were quick to retrieve them afterwards, but I wonder...

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000760_ALISAIE
76.description: Out with it, Brother. You fear they might contain bombs or war machines?

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000770_HIEN
77.description: If the ambassador wanted me dead, he has had ample opportunity. No, assassination is not his intent, but we should be on our guard for other acts of treachery.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000780_DOMANMAID
78.description: My lord! Forgive me, but the lady Yotsuyu─she's gone!

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000800_DOMANMAID
80.description: I beg your pardons, my lords. I was certain she had fallen asleep...

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000810_HIEN
81.description: No, no, the responsibility is mine. 'Twas I who gave her a room instead of a cell.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000820_HIEN
82.description: She may simply have wandered outside. We will organize search parties.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000821_HIEN
83.description: Might I call upon your assistance?

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000870_YOTSUYU
88.description: But I will not suffer his kindness. Not after what I did to him.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000890_ASAHIMOTHER
90.description: <gasp> ...Oh, it's you. What are you doing out here in the dark?

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000900_ASAHIFATHER
91.description: This is the enclave, is it? When the soldiers dragged us back to Doma, you were the last person I expected to see.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000910_ASAHIMOTHER
92.description: You're the bane of our existence, Yotsuyu! A font of misery!

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000920_ASAHIMOTHER
93.description: You couldn't even do us the simple courtesy of dying, could you! Oh no, you had to <hex:021A020203>live<hex:021A020103> and taint us with the shame of your failure!

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000930_ASAHIMOTHER
94.description: We had a perfect life in the capital! And now they're making us wallow in this muddy ruin like common swine! I don't deserve this!

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000940_ASAHIFATHER
95.description: Now, now, dear, that'll do. There seems little point in berating the girl when she scarcely remembers her own name. Our time would be better spent contemplating how we're to survive this unhappy predicament.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000950_ASAHIFATHER
96.description: You've kept your looks at least. I suspect you'd fetch a handsome price with the right buyer. Maybe enough to get us to Kugane and start a new business...

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000980_YOTSUYU
100.description: Ah, my beloved parents. No sooner do I wake from gentle slumber than the world returns in all its cruelty. Yes, this is how it always was. How it was meant to be.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_000990_YOTSUYU
101.description: Very well. If I cannot escape my nature, then I shall embrace it.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001000_YOTSUYU
102.description: To the very depths I have sunk, my soul steeped in spite and rotten to the core. The self-righteous hide behind “justice,” but I need no such mask.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001010_YOTSUYU
103.description: Father. Mother. Was it not you who made me into this monster? Who taught me the truth of this miserable world?

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001020_YOTSUYU
104.description: For years I knew naught but the taste of pain and humiliation, but the time has come to savor my vengeance against Doma. Against all my enemies.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001060_ASAHI
109.description: Well done, dear sister. Did I not say you would come back to us?

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001080_YOTSUYU
111.description: You always were a cold-blooded little worm. I doubt you thought twice about sending our parents to their deaths.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001090_ASAHI
112.description: Your dagger yet drips with their blood and you presume to judge <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103>? To be frank, I didn't think you had the strength to slay them so cleanly. A single thrust each... I'm impressed!

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001100_ASAHI
113.description: But surely you can't be satisfied with murdering a pair of doddering elders. You yearn for a deeper vengeance...and the power to see it through.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001110_ASAHIFATHER
114.description: Please... I don't want to die...

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001140_HIEN
117.description: I knew what would happen if she recovered, and <hex:021A020203>still<hex:021A020103> I did nothing. ...You say she left with her brother?

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001150_HIEN
118.description: Whatever he wants with her, he was willing to pay for it with his parents' lives...

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001160_HIEN
119.description: But this is neither the time nor the place. We must gather the others.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001170_ASAHI
120.description: At last, the hour has come. The conclusion to these negotiations will mark a new beginning for Doma and the Empire─a first step on the road to peaceful coexistence!

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001180_HIEN
121.description: Indeed. We are ready to proceed with the exchange when you are.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001190_HIEN
122.description: Forgive my curiosity, Ambassador, but is there a purpose to these containers you bring with you?

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001200_ASAHI
123.description: Oh, the supply crates? They are filled with materials we hoped might be of use in Doma's restoration. I meant to gift them to you at our last meeting, but we had so much else to discuss...

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001210_HIEN
124.description: How very generous. I confess, I had not expected such compassion, welcome though it is.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001220_HIEN
125.description: ...But then I was <hex:021A020203>also<hex:021A020103> surprised by the news that one of our captives had delivered herself into your custody ahead of time─a minor discrepancy I shall overlook in the spirit of the occasion.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001230_YOTSUYU
126.description: Are you perhaps referring to me, Lord Hien?

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001250_YOTSUYU
128.description: Orphan of the Naeuri, widow of Sashihai...

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001260_YOTSUYU
129.description: ...And acting viceroy of Doma! You and your people are mine to govern; mine to punish!

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001270_HIEN
130.description: Well, well. It would seem your shattered mind is mended. As per our agreement with the ambassador, you are free to return with him to the Empire.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001271_HIEN
131.description: Your authority as acting viceroy, however, is no longer recognized here.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001280_YOTSUYU
132.description: My position is not for you to decide, little lordling.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001290_YOTSUYU
133.description: All who resist the rule of the Empire must be purged. Such was the order given to me by Lord Zenos himself!

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001300_YOTSUYU
134.description: I will reign here in this putrid, pestilent swamp until the last of you has been broken!

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001310_YOTSUYU
135.description: This land shall know no dawn. I will spew forth darkness and drown all in eternal night. And high above you I shall shine uncaring, cold and distant as the moon!

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001330_ALPHINAUD
137.description: Oh, gods... This is a summoning!

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001340_ASAHI
138.description: A Doman citizen has called forth an eikon in direct violation of our primary agreement. The negotiations have failed. Abandon the captives, and make preparations to withdraw.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001360_ASAHI
140.description: Disobey me, Pilus, and you disobey the Emperor. Make preparations to withdraw─<hex:021A020203>now<hex:021A020103>.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001380_YUGIRI
142.description: My lord! You must fall back!

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001400_HIEN
147.description: Bah... Against such a foe, I would be more hindrance than help. The field is yours!

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001410_HIEN
148.description: Spare my pride, would you? I know this foe is beyond me. The field is yours!

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001420_HIEN
149.description: We will withdraw...but not without our countrymen. I want every soul accounted for. Every soul!

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001440_TSUKUYOMI
151.description: (-???-)I knew you would not flee. I see now the strength which flows from that baleful light of yours.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001450_TSUKUYOMI
152.description: (-Tsukuyomi-)But I am become Tsukuyomi, goddess of the moon and divinity of night. What power can compare to such celestial majesty!?

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001460_TSUKUYOMI
153.description: I shall plunge all I despise into darkness! And within that black abyss, even your light shall flicker and fail.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001470_TSUKUYOMI
154.description: Come, let us cast the stalks and look upon the fate of Doma. I see a future in which the sun sets on this wretched land once and for all!

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001500_ASAHI
157.description: You really must learn to finish the job.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001510_ASAHI
158.description: 'Tis true that a gaudy mirror and a handful of crystals make for a feeble summoning, but even the weakest eikon is a god of sorts. A threat that must be put down.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001520_ASAHI
159.description: My, my, such hostility! These beings are the sworn enemies of the Empire─I merely did my duty as an imperial officer.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001530_ASAHI
160.description: Will you surrender to anger, then? Slay an anointed emissary to avenge a fallen foe?

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001540_ASAHI
161.description: You cannot, of course. To do so would burn the bridges we have labored so hard to build!

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001550_ASAHI
162.description: Ah, but I'm forgetting: they're already ash! This <hex:021A020203>Doman<hex:021A020103> woman has seen to that! The Empire cannot ally itself with any nation that refuses to renounce summoning. I believe I was most clear on that point!

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001580_ASAHI
165.description: The power he bestowed upon her... I should have been the one to govern Doma! <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> would have repaid his faith!

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001581_ASAHI
166.description: No one alive loves him more than I!

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001630_YOTSUYU
171.description: Thank you, dear brother...for this precious gift. Vengeance.

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001640_YOTSUYU
172.description: These people...<hex:021A020203>our<hex:021A020103> people...they ignore the corruption which festers beneath the surface. Cast aside that which is dirty and broken. Speak not of things which would disrupt their dreary little lives.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001650_YOTSUYU
173.description: Like you, Asahi...always pretending not to see. You were the first...the first I swore to kill.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001670_YOTSUYU
175.description: Ahhh...such bliss. I had thought my hunger insatiable...but now...now I am satisfied.

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001680_YOTSUYU
176.description: You should feel honored, dear brother. I saved the last of my strength just...for you.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001690_YOTSUYU
177.description: What's the matter? The witch of Doma will soon be dead.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001710_YOTSUYU
182.description: Her happiness was never to be... Not in this world.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001720_YOTSUYU
183.description: I wonder... Was the fruit as sweet...as he remembered...?

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001760_ROBEMAN
187.description: (-Zenos-)Asahi. You were born of Doma, yes?

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001770_ASAHI
188.description: Yes, my lord! I am honored that you would remember me. How may I serve?

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001780_ROBEMAN
189.description: (-Zenos-)You are hereby appointed ambassador plenipotentiary, and empowered to speak with the voice of the Emperor. Return to your native land of Doma, and announce your intention to sue for peace.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001800_ROBEMAN
191.description: (-Zenos-)Once negotiations are underway, you are to locate the acting viceroy.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001810_ASAHI
192.description: She <hex:021A020203>lives<hex:021A020103>? That is to say─I will, my lord.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001820_ROBEMAN
193.description: (-Zenos-)When you have found her, you will initiate a ritual to call forth an eikon. I will instruct you in the necessary steps.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001830_ROBEMAN
194.description: (-Zenos-)Yotsuyu's faith is unreliable. But as a child raised to believe in the kami, she will serve as a vessel for one of the Kojin's gods. She need only wish it to be so.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001840_ROBEMAN
195.description: (-Zenos-)The power will seem a gift, but the eikon's essence will consume her. She will be no more than a husk, a slave to whim and desire.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001850_ASAHI
196.description: My lord, ever since the day you saw fit to save my miserable life, I have dreamed of repaying your benevolence. Upon my honor, I swear to devote myself wholly to your service. All that you command will be done, no matter the cost.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001860_ASAHI
197.description: B-But...I fear the subtleties of your plan yet elude me. From the reports I have heard, the champion who aids the Doman resistance would make short work of a single eikon...

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001870_ROBEMAN
198.description: (-Zenos-)The eikon is merely a message. The pacifist teachings of the Populares spread through this city like a plague, and I would remind the people of the threat we face.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001880_ROBEMAN
199.description: (-Zenos-)You will be my chosen agent─the hand which tolls the warning bell. The salvation of this world will not be won through the signing of treaties.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001900_ASAHI
201.description: I will not fail you, my lord!

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001910_ASAHI
202.description: My... My master... Lord Zenos... He will come...for you.

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001940_GOSETSU
205.description: Wherefore did the kami spare us only to inflict this pain...?

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001960_HIEN
207.description: Death shall not want for company this day. You spared us a worse disaster, but I fear our fledgling peace with the Empire was beyond saving.

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001980_HIEN
209.description: Maxima, is it not? I assumed you long fled.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_001990_MAXIMA
210.description: I entertain thoughts of escape even now. But our negotiations have yet to reach a satisfying conclusion. The ambassador insisted that the summoning spelled an end to our mission here, but it seemed to me there was more to the tale...

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_A3_000_001_NONE_VOICE
212.description: I saw a vision of Asahi's past...

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002000_MAXIMA
214.description: I have heard tell of this power you wield. And in your vision, you witnessed Lord Zenos giving these orders?

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002010_HIEN
215.description: But how can that be? Zenos is dead. He took his own life after the battle in Ala Mhigo.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002020_HIEN
216.description: I saw his body with my own eyes!

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002030_MAXIMA
217.description: Forgive me, but Lord Zenos is very much alive─he granted our party an audience prior to our departure. That he was gravely wounded is certain, but his recovery appeared to be proceeding apace.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002040_ALPHINAUD
218.description: I am afraid I share Lord Hien's confusion. The man's death was confirmed and his remains interred. These are matters of public record.

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002050_MAXIMA
219.description: ...Hmm. I have no doubt you believe what you say.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002060_MAXIMA
220.description: But what then is the explanation? That an impostor has infiltrated the innermost circle of the imperial court? The idea is inconceivable, <hex:021A020203>absurd<hex:021A020103>...but worthy of investigation nonetheless. Our movement can ill afford to have a highly placed pretender undermining our efforts...

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002070_HIEN
221.description: Your efforts may yet bear fruit. Tell me, what is to become of our prisoner exchange? Though we have already taken custody of our conscripts, we have yet to release your imperial comrades. Do you still intend to collect them?

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002080_MAXIMA
222.description: Ah. Yes, as the late ambassador's second-in-command, it falls to me to speak on the Empire's behalf. And I am happy to confirm our intent to proceed according to the original agreement.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002090_HIEN
223.description: Then let us be about it. 'Twould be a pity to abandon such a promising beginning.

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002100_MAXIMA
224.description: Indeed. You have my thanks, Lord Hien. As soon as our people are secure aboard our airship, we shall depart straightways for Garlemald.

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002110_HIEN
225.description: Tread lightly, Pilus. I sense treachery awaits you there.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002120_ALPHINAUD
226.description: Might I accompany you to the capital?

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002140_ALPHINAUD
228.description: Impostor or no, if Zenos was instructing Asahi on the finer points of ritual summoning, then experience tells us there is an Ascian waiting in the wings.

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002150_ALPHINAUD
229.description: Without our knowledge and expertise, our new friends will be hard-pressed to contend with a foe for whom death is but a minor inconvenience. They need our help.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002160_MAXIMA
230.description: Were you indeed willing to share your knowledge of this enemy, we would not shun your counsel.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002170_HIEN
231.description: You truly mean to do this? In full knowledge of the danger?

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002180_ALPHINAUD
232.description: I have seen the Warrior of Light risk his life on countless occasions. Next to him, I am scarce more than a distraction on the battlefield.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002190_ALPHINAUD
233.description: I have seen the Warrior of Light risk her life on countless occasions. Next to her, I am scarce more than a distraction on the battlefield.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002200_ALPHINAUD
234.description: But in the meeting room or the audience chamber, <hex:021A020203>there<hex:021A020103> I can make a difference. I can strike bargains, forge ties, and change minds. And where better to do these things than in the home of our old enemy?

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002210_HIEN
238.description: 'Tis not for me to stop you─but I would have you consider an alternative arrangement. Rather than braving the Empire as a simple traveler, go forth as an emissary of Doma. Such a position should offer you some measure of protection.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002220_ALISAIE
239.description: Go, then. You've obviously made up your mind.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002221_ALISAIE
240.description: Just try not to do anything reckless, all right?

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002230_ALPHINAUD
241.description: I shall be on my best behavior. Farewell, my friends.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002240_HIEN
242.description: How often have I imagined this moment... Thank you for helping it come to pass.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002270_YUGIRI
245.description: My friend... What have you done...?

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002280_GOSETSU
246.description: An old man who cannot raise his blade has no place in the service of a young lord.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002290_GOSETSU
247.description: Thus did I decide to devote my remaining days to pilgrimage. I will walk this land, offering prayers of repose for all the souls who left this life in suffering.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002310_GOSETSU
252.description: A fulsome farewell makes for an enjoyable journey!

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002320_GOSETSU
253.description: This is no forlorn and final farewell! Send me on my way with a smile, my friends!

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002330_HIEN
254.description: Scarcely have we said our good-byes to Alphinaud, and you leave us too. Ah, but 'tis well that my companions find their own way forward. I must endeavor to do the same.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002340_GOSETSU
255.description: I have faith that you will find the best path for Doma without me, my lord. Pray forgive me this last act of selfishness, and grant me your blessing.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002350_HIEN
256.description: You have earned it. A thousand times over!

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002360_HIEN
257.description: Go in peace, my friend. I shall make of Doma a land where children laugh and none need live in fear.

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002370_GOSETSU
258.description: There is no better way to honor those who went before...

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002380_GOSETSU
259.description: And with that I take my leave!

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002390_THANCRED
260.description: Oh dear. We seem to be missing a corpse.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04300_002400_ALISAIE
261.description: Well it must be somewhere. I only hope it isn't walking around...
